newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: TWO KILLED IN ROCKFALL AT ZAMBIA'S MUFULIRA MINE.
newsitem.headline: TWO KILLED IN ROCKFALL AT ZAMBIA'S MUFULIRA MINE.

text.p: Two miners were killed in a rockfall at Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines' Mufulira copper mine this week, a company official said on Thursday.
ZCCM spokesman Francis Musonda said in a statement five other miners were injured in the rockfall and production had not been affected.
He said the accident occurred at 900 metres underground at 23H04 local time on Monday.
"The rockfall was as a result of a seismic event which happened without prior warning," Musonda said.
"There has been no interruption of other mining operations which continue as normal," he added.
The mine produced around 52,000 tonnes of copper in concentrate in 1995-96.
